_doc: SKU Guard rules. One place for the numbers that decide whether a Jatalia SKU is making money. Read by sku_guard.py. Edit here, not in the script.

mode._note: amazon_reprice: live | approval | dry_run | off. 'approval' (set 2026-10-03): sku_guard.py only proposes; the jatalia-standup agent applies a price only after a person approves its group in the Slack approval thread. Walmart stays alert_only until Walmart Marketplace API credentials exist (only Walmart Ads creds are set).

cost_basis._note: Product cost per SKU = PRODUCT COST in amazon_cogs.csv (the direct-ship / FBM rate). FBA and FBM pay the same product cost; only shipping differs. If Earthwise confirms a different rate, change it in amazon_cogs.csv.

fbm_shipping_by_weight._note: What Earthwise bills per direct-ship unit, by pack size. Calibrated to the Jul 6-19 and Sep 14-27 Amazon reimbursements (billed shipping / FBM units, weighted by size): carrier-rate tiers x 1.2.

ezdia._source: eZdia invoice #9512 (Jul 2026): 3.25% revenue share + flat monthly management fee per channel. Flat fee is spread over the channel's trailing-30-day revenue.

flat_fee_in_sku_pricing._note: Walmart's flat fee is ~30% of Walmart sales at current volume - a channel problem, not fixable per SKU, so it is reported as a channel alert instead of loaded into each Walmart SKU.

open_invoice_disputes.issue: FBA/WFS stock billed at 2x the direct-ship rate (Seed-Tac ~4x); $6,900.50 over on the two invoices

slack._visibility: Shared channel: margins %, revenue $, ROAS, prices, stock, Buy Box; Shopify as % only. Steven's DM only: profit $, Earthwise costs/rates/invoice amounts, eZdia fees and contract terms.

team._note: Who gets tagged for what. slack_id null = resolve each run by name from Slack users.list (exactly one active, non-bot match on first name or an alias); until then write the name as plain text. Set slack_id here to pin it.

approvals._note: Only these people's replies approve price changes. Anyone else's 'approve' is ignored and answered in the thread. Default set 2026-10-03 — Steven to confirm.
